answers.q1: This reads as ONE unified application surface. The floating toolbar at the top is clearly part of the app (not a separate window), the left panel shows the meeting info, and the right panel shows AI-generated transcription and analysis. All elements share consistent styling and layout. The floating toolbar could theoretically feel detached, but it's visually integrated as a compact control area.
answers.q2: Yes, very clear. The app is recording a meeting scheduled for 14:50 (2:50 PM). The source is real-time audio input (it's currently listening). You can tell it's waiting to capture decisions and action items from the discussion in this specific meeting.
answers.q3: Right now: The app is actively recording (red dot + 00:02 elapsed timer) and listening to real-time audio input. It is waiting for: speech to be captured and transcribed, and for discussion content that will populate the 'Decided Things' and 'Things To Do' sections. The right panel confirms 'No speech yet' (まだ発話がありません).
answers.q4: The most important information: (1) Recording is active (red indicator + timer), (2) The meeting it is recording (14:50 meeting title), (3) The status that it's listening and ready to capture decisions and actions. The meeting time/subject anchors what is being acted upon.
answers.q5: Mostly clear, but a few areas could be improved: (1) The floating toolbar buttons are not obviously labeled—a first-time user won't immediately know what each icon does without hovering or tooltips; (2) The 'Materials AI is viewing' link at the bottom is truncated/unclear—what materials is it seeing?; (3) The right panel being empty ('No speech yet') is expected during startup, but it reads as inactive and waiting.

weaknesses.what: Floating toolbar buttons are not labeled. Icons alone don't communicate their function to a first-time user.
weaknesses.fix: Add a tooltip on hover, or use icon + label for at least the most important controls (pause/play, maximize, recording stop).

weaknesses.what: 'AIが見ている資料' (Materials AI is viewing) at the bottom is cut off or unclear. What materials? Where do they come from?
weaknesses.fix: Either show a preview/list of the materials, or clarify in a tooltip what this section displays.

weaknesses.what: Right panel shows 'No speech yet' which is expected, but it reads as empty/inactive to a newcomer. Might feel like the app is not working.
weaknesses.fix: Add a light hint or placeholder message like 'Awaiting transcription...' or 'Start speaking to see transcription here' to signal the app is ready and working.
